title: Declare CustomLookAndFeel header and palette
description:
Create Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h defining class CustomLookAndFeel : public juce::LookAndFeel_V4 with exact palette Colour constants and override declarations only (no .cpp bodies).

Palette (hex must match exactly):
- Background #121417
- Panel #1A1D22
- Border #2C3038
- Maximizer accent #00D2FF
- Exciter accent #FF9500
- Master accent #34C759
- Text #F2F2F7

Declare public static Colour (or juce::Colour) constants for each, plus overrides for drawRotarySlider, drawComboBox (and related ComboBox drawing helpers as needed by JUCE LookAndFeel_V4), and drawToggleButton. No audio-thread APIs. No heap policy changes. This task owns the header only; phase-a stub is superseded here as single owner for the header.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/GUI/ for any existing CustomLookAndFeel stub from phase a
- Source/PluginEditor.h for LookAndFeel usage patterns
- JUCE LookAndFeel_V4 override signatures for rotary slider, ComboBox, ToggleButton
- CMakeLists.txt / JUCE version pin for Font API notes (JUCE 8)
acceptance_criteria: Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h exists and declares class CustomLookAndFeel publicly deriving from juce::LookAndFeel_V4
Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h defines palette Colours Background #121417, Panel #1A1D22, Border #2C3038, Maximizer #00D2FF, Exciter #FF9500, Master #34C759, Text #F2F2F7
Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h declares overrides for drawRotarySlider, ComboBox drawing, and drawToggleButton
Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h contains no function bodies beyond inline constants if required
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change hex palette values away from the specified design colours

allowed: declare LookAndFeel_V4 subclass header with palette Colour constants
declare rotary/ComboBox/ToggleButton draw overrides matching JUCE signatures
forbidden: allocate on the audio thread or add locks
change plugin formats or CMake targets
